"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Whiteness is a modern sociological construction.",

"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"DSA organizes for the reinstatement of treaty rights for indigenous people.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The development of capitalism in the U.S. relied heavily on forced displacement of indigenous people.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"DSA’s political project must oppose settler colonialism.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Ending white supremacy will require redistribution.",

"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Ending white supremacy will require expansion of legal rights.",

"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"In the long term, DSA fights for the abolition of police and prisons.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
